exposure: IR insertion of internal iliac balloon catheters
cohort: Women with very severe placenta accreta spectrum (FIGO stage 3b & c) who underwent caesarean hysterectomy with either surgical devascularisation or IR balloon catheters in a UK tertiary referral centre between 2011 and 2022.
finding: The Soleymani and Collins (SAC) technique for surgical devascularisation safely and effectively controls haemorrhage during caesarean hysterectomy for severe placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), demonstrating a reduction in median estimated blood loss compared to IR balloon catheter insertion.
